label: Tâi-lô sounds
desc: One word for each Tâi-lô letter or ending that misleads English readers: ph, th, kh, tsh, b, g, j, oo, nn, and the stops -p -t -k -h.

label: Seven tones
desc: The tone mnemonic 獅虎豹鱉猴狗象鹿 (sai hóo pà pih kâu káu tshiūnn lo̍k): one animal per tone, with its mark.

label: Tone sandhi in action
desc: Two-syllable words whose first syllable is said in its sandhi tone, while the last keeps the tone you see.

label: Taigi characters
desc: Characters that Taiwanese writes and Mandarin does not use this way: 毋, 佇, 欲, 予, 媠, 囝, 厝, 睏, 啉.

label: Greetings and courtesy
desc: Good morning, have you eaten?, thank you, sorry and goodbye.

label: People and family
desc: Pronouns (我, 你, 伊, 阮, 咱, 恁, 𪜶) and the family words a grandchild needs.

label: About me
desc: Name, surname, being a student, where you live.

label: In class
desc: Asking the teacher to repeat, to slow down, and saying you don't know.

label: Numbers and money
desc: Counting numbers, the literary numbers for digits, and prices in 箍.

label: Classifiers
desc: Number or this / that + classifier + noun: 个, 本, 隻, 碗, 杯, 擺.

label: Night market food
desc: The night market, its stalls and its food.

label: At the market
desc: The traditional market: vegetables, meat, eggs, fish and fruit, and haggling over price.

label: Time and days
desc: Today, tomorrow, yesterday, parts of the day, the week and the clock.

label: Places and directions
desc: In front, behind, above, below, left, right, and turning.

label: Getting around
desc: MRT, trains, taxis, walking, getting on.

label: Questions and particles
desc: Question words and the yes/no questions with 無, 未, 敢 and 是毋是.

label: Describing and comparing
desc: Very, too, more, most; and actions in progress or done.

label: Traps for English speakers
desc: No "to be" with adjectives, the four negatives, 會 and 袂, sound-alikes and false friends.

label: Compliments
desc: Praise for food, work, effort and homes, and the modest answers Taiwanese people give back (無啦！).

label: Flirting
desc: Warm, respectful flirting: the words (古錐, 目睭), phrases built from them, asking someone out, and kind ways to say yes or no.

label: Top nouns
desc: Common everyday nouns: people, family, food, things at home.

label: Top verbs
desc: Common verbs and modal verbs (會, 會使, 會當, 捌). Taigi verbs never change form.

label: Top adjectives
desc: Common adjectives. No 是 before an adjective: 真好, 傷貴.

label: Top adverbs
desc: Very, more, all, again, already, now, often, not yet: they go before the verb.

label: Top pronouns
desc: They, the possessives with 的, this and that, oneself, everyone, other people.

label: Top prepositions
desc: What Taigi uses for prepositions: coverbs (共, 比, 對, 用, 到) and place words after the noun (邊仔, 對面, 中央).

label: Top conjunctions
desc: Or, but, if, then, because, so, although, after, before.

label: Top interjections
desc: Short exclamations and replies: really?, that's wrong!, careful!, oh well.

label: Top words
desc: Numbers to thirty and beyond, how many, half, first, yes/no questions, days and weeks.

label: Top measure words
desc: More classifiers, one per card: books, animals, clothes, flat things, pairs, dollars, years of age, o'clock.

label: Top particles
desc: The small words that change a sentence: 矣, 啦, 咧, the question endings 無 / 未 / 袂, 敢, 的, 仔, 過.
